description: Complete the whole 480x352 native pixel-art cave environment ONLY inside the white mask. The black-masked lower-right cave area is the approved original and must remain exact: same pixels, same small stairs/tunnel size, no zoom and no redraw. The surrounding masked area must become continuous matching dark cavern ceiling and walls seamlessly growing from those edges. Add extensive high vaulted rock ceiling with natural connected stalactites, charcoal blue-slate planes, restrained cracks and subdued cool highlights. Extra left wall and right wall continue the cave, matching exact native pixel density, crisp dark outlines, quiet broad shading, limited original colors. Let the left distant blue cave shaft rise naturally farther up into the added space, but keep the added uppermost 60 pixels calm dark ceiling. Match and continue every original boundary plane, no rectangular cut line. Opaque background fills every pixel to every edge; no uniform colored bands, no borders, no empty canvas, no transparency. No repeated old cave image or mirrored tunnel. No new giant tunnel opening, no characters, no words, UI, props or floor separator. This is an extended scenery asset for a 2D sidescroller combat background, with original focal cave unchanged at native size and a new tall ceiling.
